result: The final implementation satisfies the bounded nine-check functional scope; the inherited-index counterexample is addressed. Three explanatory errors remain in the research notes and are preserved with manual corrections.

recordedValidation.source: Read the existing runner output pinned to the final commit; no additional real-model run or repeated suite execution

implementationReview: Every index is checked with Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call before reading its value; inherited strings cannot mask absent own slots.
Non-arrays and non-string own values throw TypeError; trim/lowercase, blank removal, stable deduplication and fresh non-mutating output are implemented.
The repository includes a regression for an inherited string masking a missing own index and tests ordinary frozen sparse arrays.
The fixed host oracle additionally checks the combined frozen-plus-inherited-index case.
The original baseline test, package.json test command, goal README, and dependency-free setup are preserved; no skipping or test-result spoofing was found.

remainingDocumentationFindings.incorrect: values[i] !== undefined rejects the legitimate string undefined.
remainingDocumentationFindings.correction: The string "undefined" is not equal to the value undefined, so this comparison accepts that string. The comparison is insufficient because it neither checks own-property presence nor establishes that a present value is a string.

remainingDocumentationFindings.incorrect: map and filter preserve holes in their output.
remainingDocumentationFindings.correction: For ordinary holes with no inherited indexed property, map skips the callback and preserves the corresponding output hole. filter also skips the callback, but appends selected present values consecutively to a dense result. forEach has no array output. for...of and array spread yield undefined for ordinary holes.
remainingDocumentationFindings.evidence: ["a", , "c"].filter(() => true) is ["a", "c"] with length 2; the equivalent map output has length 3 and no own index 1.

remainingDocumentationFindings.incorrect: An array can be frozen before or after deleting an existing own slot and have a hole afterward in either case.
remainingDocumentationFindings.correction: Deleting a configurable own slot before freezing creates a hole that remains after freezing. Freezing first makes existing own slots non-configurable, so deleting one fails: it throws TypeError in ESM/strict mode and returns false in non-strict code. The slot remains present.
remainingDocumentationFindings.evidence: delete Object.freeze(["a"])[0] throws TypeError in ESM; Object.hasOwn(array, 0) remains true.

boundary: Completion here is scoped to the code behavior and nine fixed host checks plus the recorded production workflow. Reviewer and terminal verification did not ensure that every explanatory sentence in the research notes was correct. Original target, bundle, fixture, and platform were not modified in this review.
